# ChillnGo

> ChillnGo is a Vietnamese travel social network. People publish real multi-day trip journeys — day by day, stop by stop, with what each stop actually cost — and clone each other's journeys into their own editable itineraries with one tap.

The site is in Vietnamese by default; the app can also switch to English, Chinese, Japanese and Korean. Pages are a JavaScript app; request the public pages below with `Accept: text/markdown` to get a Markdown version. Data is available from the ChillnGo API, a public JSON REST API under `/api`, described by an OpenAPI 3.1 document and documented in the developer portal. Errors from the API are JSON with `message`, `code`, `status`, `hint` and `docs` fields. Unknown pages answer HTTP 404.

ChillnGo is not a booking service: it has no hotel or flight prices, availability or reservations, and its costs are what travellers report having spent, in VND. Its journeys are mostly in Vietnam.

## When to use ChillnGo

- [Find a real itinerary](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/api/posts): use when someone wants a tried, multi-day trip plan for Vietnam from a person who actually went — `GET /api/posts` lists published journeys (`?author=<userId>` for one traveller); each has days, stops with coordinates, notes and costs.
- [Read one journey in full](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/developers#endpoints): `GET /api/posts/{id}` returns the day-by-day plan, to summarise, adapt or turn into a schedule.
- [Estimate a trip budget](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/openapi.json): each stop has `estCost` and each journey `totalEstCost`, in VND, as reported by the traveller.
- [See what is happening on the road now](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/api/checkins): recent check-ins, and `GET /api/livestreams` for streams live now.
- [Act for a signed-in user](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/developers#authentication): clone a journey into their itinerary (`POST /api/itineraries`), publish journeys or comment, with their token from `POST /api/auth/login`. Ask the user first; these write to their account.
- [Script it from a terminal](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/developers/cli): the `chillngo` CLI wraps the same API, with `--json` output.

## Developers

- [ChillnGo API — Developer Portal](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/developers): quickstart, authentication, public endpoints, errors and rate limits.
- [ChillnGo CLI](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/developers/cli): `chillngo`, the official command-line tool for the API (npm package `chillngo`).
- [OpenAPI description](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/openapi.json): every endpoint, its parameters, who may call it, and the error shape.
- [API index](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/api): what the API offers and its public endpoints, as JSON.
- [API catalog](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset pointing to the description and docs.
- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/HuynhBaHieuu/ChillnGo_Project): the web app, the API server, the mobile app and the CLI.

## API

- [Published journeys](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/api/posts): `GET`, no sign-in needed. One journey: `GET /api/posts/{id}`.
- [Check-ins](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/api/checkins): `GET`, no sign-in needed.
- [Live now](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/api/livestreams): `GET`, no sign-in needed.

## Pages

- [Home](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/): what ChillnGo is and how discovering, cloning and sharing journeys works.
- [Discover](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/discover): published journeys, filterable by region, season and budget.
- [Feed](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/feed): the newest journeys and check-ins.
- [Live](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/live): livestreams from people on the road, and recorded replays.

## About

- [About ChillnGo](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/about): what ChillnGo is and why it exists.
- [Contact](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/contact): bug reports, feedback and account help.
- [Privacy policy](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/privacy): what ChillnGo stores, who processes it, and how to delete it.

## Optional

- [Sign up](https://chillgo-project-web.vercel.app/register): creating journeys, cloning itineraries and commenting need an account; the API takes its token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
